subject: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@velotech.com>, Anson Lee <anson.lee@velotech.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook

Hi Maya / Anson,

Thanks again for confirming the week of Dec 6 for Anson's visit. I wanted to start a single thread to coordinate travel and the EA-to-EA handoff so we can keep the logistics tidy. High-level items we need to lock down:

- Confirm travel dates and preferred arrival/departure windows for Anson.
- Hotel preference (we typically book The Jasper or The Meridian for downtown visits).
- Ground transportation (airport pickup vs. car service vs. rideshare).
- Meeting guest list and who needs rooms/AV access on-site.
- Any dietary restrictions, mobility or security constraints (SIDA badge requests, escorts).

Tessa (cc) will manage the itinerary and vendor bookings from our side. Rishi will coordinate final meeting agenda items with your team. Laura is looping in for approval of any exception requests (late-night arrivals, additional rooms).

Can you share Anson's flight preferences (airlines, window/aisle), passport expiry if international travel is required, and preferred hotel? If easier, feel free to send an EA-to-EA call; Tessa is flexible next week for a 20-minute sync.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_travel_cheatsheet.pdf (see internal booking windows)

From: Maya Patel <m.patel@velotech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anson Lee <anson.lee@velotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — happy to coordinate. Quick answers:

- Anson prefers direct flights where possible; will prioritize United or Delta. He prefers aisle seats.
- Arrival: Dec 6 late morning (aiming for 11:00–13:00 local). Departure: Dec 8 afternoon (no earlier than 14:00).
- Hotel: The Jasper is preferred; The Meridian is acceptable if Jasper is sold out.
- Ground: We prefer a car service pickup from the airport; please provide driver contact the day before.
- Passport: no visa required; passport expires 2028.
- Dietary: pescatarian; no allergies.

I've attached a preliminary rooming list with two additional guests (VP Finance and an external counsel) — file: velotech_hotel_rooming_list.csv. Also looping in Anson to confirm.

If it helps, I'm available for an EA-to-EA call Wednesday 11/10 at 9:30 PT.

Best,

Maya Patel
Executive Assistant to Anson Lee, CFO
Velotech
m.patel@velotech.com | +1 212-555-0147

Attachment: velotech_hotel_rooming_list.csv (3 rows)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@velotech.com>
Cc: Anson Lee <anson.lee@velotech.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook

Perfect — thanks Maya.

Tessa: can you run availability at The Jasper for Dec 5 (arrive evening) through Dec 8 (checkout 12/8 in the afternoon) and hold a block for 3 rooms plus 1 rollaway? Also please get a car service quote and confirm driver details.

Rishi: I'll plan to send the draft agenda by EOD Monday; please flag any timing constraints for Anson's panels.

Maya — we'll take the 11/10 EA call. Tessa will send a calendar invite for 9:30 PT. I'll attach the first-pass itinerary for internal review.

Thanks,

Naomi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachment: travel_itinerary_v1.docx (internal draft)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@velotech.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook

Hi Maya and team,

Thanks for the call today — great to meet you, Maya. Per our conversation I've updated the itinerary and confirmed the hotel hold at The Jasper (block until 11/25). Highlights and actions:

- Hotel: The Jasper — 3 rooms held (Dec 5–8), 1 rollaway available on request. Hotel confirmation number: JAS-7781.
- Airport pickup: Sterling Car Service booked tentatively for arrival on 12/6 at 12:15 PM. Driver: Marcus (cell: +1 415-555-0823). I will confirm 24 hours prior and share driver's photo.
- Meeting rooms: Main workshop room (Room C) reserved 12/6–12/7 08:00–17:00. AV: projector + lapel mic. AV lead on-site: Marco (av@jasperhotel.com).
- Meals: lunch catered both days (pescatarian option flagged).
- Security: We'll provide a temporary visitor badge at registration; Anson's escort will be Laura's team unless Velotech requests dedicated security.
- Guest list: Got it — Anson + VP Finance + external counsel + 2 Redwood SMEs.

Attachments: travel_itinerary_v2.pdf (attached below) — includes flight suggestions, hotel check-in, draft day-by-day agenda, and vendor contacts.

Requests for Maya: please confirm the two additional guest names to finalize rooming, and send any preferred driver notes. Also confirm whether Anson needs a dietary kosher option for the evening dinner on 12/6.

I'll send the calendar invites for all meetings and the driver contact once flight is booked.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Executive Assistant to Sales & Accounts, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0107

Attachment: travel_itinerary_v2.pdf (12KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@velotech.com>, Anson Lee <anson.lee@velotech.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Velotech CFO onsite — travel & EA coordination playbook (final confirmations)

Maya / Anson — final confirmations and a couple closing items before we lock everything in: 

1) Flights: Travel coordinator will book per Anson's preference once you confirm which itinerary you prefer from the two flight options in travel_itinerary_v2.pdf. Please reply by EOD 11/30 if you want us to proceed.
2) Hotel: Jasper hold has been extended and will be converted to firm booking once Anson's flight is charged.
3) Driver: Sterling Car Service confirmed; driver Marcus will text the mobile the evening before pickup and will meet at Door 3.
4) AV/Rooms: AV lead Marco will arrive at 07:30 on 12/6 for audio checks.
5) Expense policy: we've sent a DocuSign for the guest expense policy and per-diem exceptions (link below). Please sign so our Travel Ops team can process corporate billing.

Maya — thank you for confirming the two additional guest names (Samir Rao, Elise Wong) — I've added them to the itinerary. Last request: can you provide Samir's arrival time?

If there are any special security escorts or NDA handling requirements, tell me now so we can route to Security & Legal. Otherwise we'll proceed to book flights and convert the Jasper hold to guaranteed.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to seeing you in December.

Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments referenced: redwood_expense_policy_docusign.pdf (DocuSign link included)
Related link: https://docusign.com/sign/abc123-velotech-expense-policy
